about: Golden vectors of the agent listing: the personas a seat lookup can find and what is wrong with or hidden about them, recorded from the Node listing. A vector is { name, project, install, expect }: project and install map a project-relative path to a file's text, and install is null when the project is its own install. Re-record with node scripts/agents-vectors.mjs.

vectors.name: a well-formed definition has no problems and no render warnings

project.fgos/agents/a.yaml:
name: a
description: a posture
persona:
  voice: plain
  style: short
  archetype: a checker
decision_boundary:
  can_decide:
    - one thing
  must_escalate:
    - another

vectors.name: keys the renderer drops are named and a block scalar description is read in full

project.fgos/agents/a.yaml:
name: a
description: >
  a long folded
  description
persona:
  voice: |
    two lines
  tone: calm
decision_boundary:
  may_decide:
    - x

agents.name: a
warnings: persona.tone is not rendered (only voice, style, archetype are)
decision_boundary.may_decide is not rendered (only can_decide, must_escalate are)

vectors.name: a file that is not valid YAML reports the parser's line and column and no description

project.fgos/agents/dup.yaml:
name: dup
name: dup
description: x

agents.name: a
problems: cannot be parsed: syntax error (line 3, column 1)

agents.name: dup
problems: cannot be parsed: duplicate key (line 2, column 1)

agents.name: malformed
problems: cannot be parsed: syntax error (line 2, column 15)

vectors.name: the first tier holding a name wins, lower copies are shadows and a yml file is ignored

agents.name: broken
problems: must declare name: broken (got "other")

vectors.name: a name in three tiers lists both lower copies in lookup order
a name in two domains is a duplicate of the domain tier and the second copy is a shadow
a project core agents folder hides the installed core personas it lacks and a project domains folder hides nothing
a project without its own core folder hides nothing from the install
a persona that names tier or prefer is refused with where model taste goes

project.fgos/agents/tiered.yaml:
name: tiered
description: x
tier: high
project.fgos/agents/both.yaml:
name: both
description: x
prefer: [claude]
tier: high

agents.name: both
problems: persona-model-taste-not-allowed: "tier" is a model choice and a persona does not make one; set it at runner.personas.<name> in the runner config

agents.name: preferred
problems: persona-model-taste-not-allowed: "prefer" is a model choice and a persona does not make one; set it at runner.personas.<name> in the runner config

agents.name: tiered
problems: persona-model-taste-not-allowed: "tier" is a model choice and a persona does not make one; set it at runner.personas.<name> in the runner config

vectors.name: values that are not text where the renderer reads text are refused by path

project.fgos/agents/voice-map.yaml:
name: voice-map
description: x

  voice: {a: b}
project.fgos/agents/item-map.yaml:

    - ok

project.fgos/agents/list-map.yaml:

decision_boundary:
  must_escalate: {a: b}
project.fgos/agents/list-text.yaml:

description: x
decision_boundary:
  can_decide: just text
project.fgos/agents/list-null.yaml:
name: list-null
description: x
decision_boundary:
  can_decide:

agents.name: desc-list
problems: description is a list, not text; an unquoted ": " inside the text makes YAML read a mapping, quote it

agents.name: item-map
problems: decision_boundary.can_decide[1] is a mapping; an unquoted ": " inside the text makes YAML read a mapping, quote it

agents.name: list-map
problems: decision_boundary.must_escalate is a mapping, not a list; an unquoted ": " inside the text makes YAML read a mapping, quote it

agents.name: list-text
problems: decision_boundary.can_decide is text, not a list

agents.name: voice-map
problems: persona.voice is a mapping, not text; an unquoted ": " inside the text makes YAML read a mapping, quote it

vectors.name: a missing, mismatched, numeric or empty name and a missing description are named

agents.name: blank
problems: must declare name: blank (got null)

agents.name: empty-desc
problems: must declare a non-empty description

agents.name: no-desc
problems: must declare a non-empty description

agents.name: no-name
problems: must declare name: no-name (got null)

agents.name: other
problems: must declare name: other (got "another")

vectors.name: an empty file and a file that is not a mapping name no declared name

agents.name: empty
problems: must declare name: empty (got null)

agents.name: list
problems: must declare name: list (got null)

agents.name: scalar
problems: must declare name: scalar (got null)

vectors.name: a description is folded to one line and scalars read like JavaScript text

description: "  one \t two\n three\u00a0four  "

vectors.name: unrendered keys are listed with array-index keys first like a JavaScript object

name: keys
description: x
persona:
  zeta: 1
  voice: v
  "10": a
  "2": b
  "02": c
  alpha: 2
decision_boundary:
  "1": x
  can_decide: [a]

agents.name: keys
warnings: persona.2 is not rendered (only voice, style, archetype are)
persona.10 is not rendered (only voice, style, archetype are)
persona.zeta is not rendered (only voice, style, archetype are)
persona.02 is not rendered (only voice, style, archetype are)
persona.alpha is not rendered (only voice, style, archetype are)
decision_boundary.1 is not rendered (only can_decide, must_escalate are)
